content:
Hi all,

Our paper on Quantum Error Correction in Lean just got posted to to the ArXiv! We formalize the theory of Quantum Error-Correcting Codes, and verify distance properties of industrially practical codes through a heavy-duty BitVec-SAT reduction workflow. This project is a step towards verifying end-to-end Quantum Computing pipelines in Lean, and provides an increased level of confidence in a number of large codes which were previously only known through unverified computer algebra.
